galaxy.title: Galaxy
galaxy.subtitle: Navigate the universe and spot available systems.

messages.title: Messages
messages.subtitle: Manage your communications with other commanders.
messages.emptyHint: Send a message to start a conversation.
messages.selectHint: Select a message to read it.

alliance.title: Alliance
alliance.subtitle: Create or join an alliance to progress together.
alliance.joinHint: Enter the alliance id received by message.
alliance.leaveHint: You will leave the alliance immediately.
alliance.leaveBlocked: The founder cannot leave without dissolving.

admin.title: Admin console
admin.subtitle: Server configuration and supervision.
admin.roleHint: Promote a player or adjust permissions.
admin.boostHint: Set all buildings and technologies to level 100.
admin.moderationHint: Ban or unban a player quickly.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.subtitle: Recommended steps to launch your empire.
onboarding.finishedBody: Your infrastructure, research and first fleet are in place. Grow your mines, colonize and explore the galaxy.

solar_plant.title: Build a Solar Plant
solar_plant.hint: Mines consume energy. Without it they run at reduced output.

metal_mine.title: Build a Metal Mine
metal_mine.hint: Metal is the base of every construction.

crystal_mine.title: Build a Crystal Mine
crystal_mine.hint: Crystal is needed for the laboratory, research and ships.

deuterium_mine.title: Build a Deuterium Synthesizer
deuterium_mine.hint: Deuterium fuels fleets and is required by the laboratory and most research.

energy_balance.title: Balance your energy
energy_balance.hint: When mines need more energy than the plant supplies, their output drops. Upgrade the Solar Plant until production reaches 100%.

research_lab.title: Build the Research Laboratory
research_lab.hint: It unlocks technologies and costs deuterium: keep your Deuterium Synthesizer running.

first_research.title: Start your first research
first_research.hint: Energy Technology is a good first choice: it opens most other technologies.

first_ship.title: Build your first ship
first_ship.hint: Check the requirements shown on each ship card; some need a research first.

first_mission.title: Send your first fleet
first_mission.hint: Transport, espionage or deployment: pick a mission on the Fleet page.

mission_report.title: Read a mission result
mission_report.hint: Reports summarize the outcome of espionage and combat missions.

energy.title: How energy works
energy.body: Mines consume the energy produced by Solar Plants. If consumption exceeds production, every mine slows down proportionally. Keep production at 100%.

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.body: Costs are spent when you start and grow with each level. The number of simultaneous constructions is limited. Plan around your scarcest resource, often deuterium.

research.title: Research
research.body: A technology needs a laboratory level and sometimes other technologies. Only one research runs at a time; the cost is paid up front.

shipyard.title: Shipyard
shipyard.body: Ships need a Shipyard and often a research. Check the requirements on each card. Orders are paid immediately and built in batches.

fleet.title: Fleet missions
fleet.body: Choose ships, a target and a mission. Fuel (deuterium) is consumed on departure. Transport and deployment deliver resources; espionage needs probes; colonization needs a colony ship.
